items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: He used Earl Palmer on drums sometimes I know; I was at a recording session once where Earl Palmer was his drummer, but he usually uses Irv Kotler, doesn't he?

ctx.x: Well, when we worked with Sinatra, the band didn't do much, unless once in awhile, somebody had to take a little extra chorus, because Sinatra did the singing, and naturally, he didn't need anyone to back him up on something where he was playing a solo. The only one he used to once in awhile play something in the same recording was Sweets -- the trumpet player.
He used Earl Palmer on drums sometimes I know; I was at a recording session once where Earl Palmer was his drummer, but he usually uses Irv Kotler, doesn't he?
